title: MAT Deform Page
summary: Official Derivative MAT Deform page reference for enabling material-side deforms and sourcing capture/bone data from SOPs, other MATs, Deform In MAT, capture attributes, and skeleton root paths.
guidance: Use this article when material-side deformation needs to be enabled or wired to capture and skeleton data.
Enable dodeform on the material before expecting material deformation to affect rendered geometry.
Use deformdata to choose whether bone data comes from a SOP, another MAT, or a Deform In MAT.
Set targetsop to the SOP containing deform capture attributes, then align pcaptpath and pcaptdata with the capture attributes produced by Bone Group SOP workflows.
Set skelrootpath to the COMP that contains the root of the skeleton used for deformation.
